easyPrerequisites:
Oko has five or more loyalty counters on it.
An opponent controls a creature with power 3 or less.
Lure attached to Sentinel.
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Oko's last ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less and Old Fat Spider.
During your next declare attackers step, declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Old Fat Spider to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Old Fat Spider triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
